rows.text: sign-extends `ecx`, forms the pointer `02F973C0 + ecx*8` in `rcx` and tail-jumps `003845F0` with it, leaving the other argument registers unchanged
clamps `ecx` to zero when it is negative (`cmovns` keeps a non-negative `ecx`), calls `00254EE0(clamped value)` and returns the clamped value
resolves `00263F10(rdx)`, reads two values by calling `00267E10(r9)` twice, and tail-jumps `00473A00(resolved pointer, second value, first value)`
resolves `00263F10(rdx)`, reads two values by calling `00267E10(r9)` twice, and tail-jumps `00473A90(resolved pointer, second value, first value)`
calls `00267F90(r9, 2)`, resolves `00263F10(rdx)`, reads two values by calling `00267E10(r9)` twice, and tail-jumps `00473A00(resolved pointer, second value, first value)`

resolves `00263F10(rdx)`; when `003D9FE0()` returns non-zero, compares `003589B0(resolved pointer)` with `003D9FA0()` and takes 1 when they are equal, else 0; when `003D9FE0()` returns zero takes 0; then tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, that 0 or 1)`
calls `00267F90(r9, 2)`, resolves `00263F10(rdx)`, reads two values by calling `00267E10(r9)` twice, and tail-jumps `00473A90(resolved pointer, second value, first value)`
calls `00267F90(r9, 2)`, reads three values by calling `00267E10(r9)` three times, resolves `00263F10(00264010(third value))` and tail-jumps `00473A00(that pointer, second value, first value)`
reads two values by calling `00267E10(r9)` twice; when the second is non-zero tail-jumps `00359410(003589B0(00264010(first value)))`, otherwise tail-jumps `00359410(0)`

builds a flag word from `r8d`: bit 0 shifted to bit 28, bit 29 set when `r8d` bit 1 is set and bit 30 set when `r8d` bit 2 is set; when `rcx` is null returns -1, otherwise tail-jumps `00329B70(003589B0(rcx), 1, edx, flag word)`
